options.name: array_add
options.description: Add new elements to the array for a key which has an array as its value.

options.name: check_type
options.description: Checks if the type of the provided O(value) matches the type of an existing default. If the types do not match, raises an error.

options.name: dict_mode
options.description: Defines the write behavior for O(type=dict) values. V(replace) writes the full dictionary, replacing any existing value. V(add) merges only the specified keys into the existing dictionary, leaving other keys untouched.

options.name: domain
options.description: The domain is a domain name of the form C(com.companyname.appname).

options.name: host
options.description: The host on which the preference should apply. The special value V(currentHost) corresponds to the C(-currentHost) switch of the defaults commandline tool.

options.name: key
options.description: The key of the user preference.

options.name: path
options.description: The path in which to search for C(defaults).

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the user defaults. If set to V(list) it queries the given parameter specified by O(key). Returns V(null) is nothing found or misspelled.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of value to write. V(dict) has been added in community.general 12.5.0.

options.name: value
options.description: The value to write. Only required when O(state=present).
